news.details:
– November 27th, 2026
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: Airports using the iniBuilds custom jetway system are now supported: GSX detects them automatically, operates their jetways from the Operate Jetways menu and opens the aircraft doors they connect to.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: Passengers and crew now walk through the iniBuilds jetways when boarding and deboarding, and the EFB status page shows those jetways' docking state.
GSX Pro NEW: Handler scripts can now see and operate every jetway at a gate in the same way for all kinds of jetways (getJetways, dockJetway, undockJetway, onJetwayDocked, onJetwayUndocked), and the existing jetway connected/disconnected callbacks now also work at gates with several jetways, such as iniBuilds airports.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: All GSX windows now open inside the simulator instead of on the desktop, so they also work in VR: the airport map, the airport customization dialog with its map editors, the aircraft editor, and the handler scripts' messages and questions.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: The airport map's satellite imagery now comes from the simulator's own Bing maps, without needing your own Bing API key.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: The airport map can show the simulator's charts (LIDO worldwide and FAA) without any sign-in, besides Navigraph, whose enroute maps are now also available as map backgrounds. The map opens at once and shows a progress indicator while an airport loads.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: The airport customization dialog is now a single window with pages for Parking, Passengers, Pushback, Operators, Paths, Details and De-Ice, and the map editors open on top of it and return to it. Distances and sizes are set with sliders limited to valid values, with finer steps while holding Shift, and values that differ among several selected positions are shown as a range.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: The Pushback page shows each pushback with a to-scale picture of its route over the airport, including the routes GSX plans by itself. The Paths page shows the routes of every vehicle, and custom vehicle paths can now be edited on the map as well as in 3D.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: Operators are chosen from a thumbnail grid, by click or drag and drop, and the fuel truck operator can now be set per parking. Parking systems are picked by brand, model and variant, with their logos.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) NEW: De-ice areas are shown on a picture of the airport and can be moved, turned and resized directly on the map.
GSX Pro NEW: The sliders in the GSX menu's settings show their value while dragged, and move in finer steps while holding Shift.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) Change: The animations of the GSX vehicles and equipment are now smoother and lighter on the simulator.
GSX (all versions) Change: Couatl engine - GSX responds faster and its movements are smoother.
GSX Pro (MSFS 2024) Change: Couatl engine - Updated to the MSFS 2024 SU6 SimConnect libraries.
GSX Pro Change: The passengers now come in separate packages for MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024, with a native version rebuilt for MSFS 2024.
GSX Pro Change: The model cache now comes pre-built with GSX, so it no longer needs to be rebuilt after an install or update, and the first start after an update is faster.
